translations.literal: In the fifth month Wolu and others defeated Yongchang; Tabuye captured Yongchang and presented him; he was executed in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Wolu defeated Yongchang. Tabuye captured him and brought him in; he was executed before the army.

sentences.zh: 東京州縣及南路系遼女直皆降。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital prefectures and counties and Jurchen on the southern route registered under Liao all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectures and counties of the Eastern Capital and Jurchen on the southern route still on Liao rolls all submitted.

sentences.zh: 詔除遼法，省稅賦，置猛安謀克一如本朝之制。

translations.literal: An edict abolished Liao law, reduced taxes and levies, and established meng'an and mouke just as in the native dynasty's system.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished Liao law, cut taxes, and organized meng'an and mouke as in the homeland.

sentences.zh: 以斡魯爲南路都統。

translations.literal: Wolu was made Commander-in-Chief of the Southern Route.
translations.idiomatic: Wolu was made commander of the southern route.

sentences.zh: 迭勃極烈阿徒罕破遼兵六萬于照散城。

translations.literal: Die Boijilie Atuhan defeated sixty thousand Liao troops at Zhaosan city.
translations.idiomatic: Die Boijilie Atuhan routed sixty thousand Liao troops at Zhaosan.

sentences.zh: 九月己亥，上獵近郊。

translations.literal: On the day jihai of the ninth month the emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the ninth month the emperor hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，南路都統斡魯來見于婆盧買水。

translations.literal: On yisi the Southern Route Commander-in-Chief Wolu came to audience at Boluimai River.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Southern Route Commander Wolu came to audience at Boluimai River.

sentences.zh: 始制金牌。

translations.literal: Gold tally-plaques were first instituted.
translations.idiomatic: Gold command plaques were instituted for the first time.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申朔，諳班勃極烈吳乞買及群臣上尊號曰大聖皇帝，改明年爲天輔元年。

translations.literal: On the first day gengshen of the twelfth month Anban Boijilie Wuqimai and the ministers presented the exalted title Great Sage Emperor, and changed the next year to the first year of Tianfu.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the twelfth month, gengshen, Anban Boijilie Wuqimai and the ministers invested him as Great Sage Emperor and named the coming year the first of Tianfu.

sentences.zh: 是月，宋使登州防禦使馬政以國書來，其略曰：「日出之分，實生聖人。

translations.literal: That month Song envoy Dengzhou Defense Commissioner Ma Zheng came with a state letter; its gist said: "In the quarter where the sun rises a sage is truly born.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Song envoy Ma Zheng, defense commissioner of Dengzhou, arrived with a state letter that read in part, "In the land where the sun rises a sage has been born.

sentences.zh: 竊聞征遼，屢破勍敵。

translations.literal: We have heard that in campaigning against Liao you have repeatedly defeated formidable enemies.
translations.idiomatic: We hear that in your campaigns against Liao you have repeatedly broken formidable foes.

sentences.zh: 若克遼之後，五代時陷入契丹漢地，願畀下邑。」

translations.literal: If after conquering Liao, the Han territories lost to the Khitan in the Five Dynasties period— we wish them granted to our lesser state."
translations.idiomatic: When Liao falls, grant us the Han lands the Khitan seized in Five Dynasties times."

sentences.zh: 二年正月庚寅，遼雙州節度使張崇降。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin of the first month of the second year Liao Shuangzhou Military Commissioner Zhang Chong surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the first month of the second year Zhang Chong, military commissioner of Liao Shuangzhou, submitted.

sentences.zh: 使散睹如宋報聘，書曰：「所請之地，今當與宋夾攻，得者有之。」

translations.literal: He sent Sandu to Song in return visit; the letter said: "As for the territories requested—now we shall attack jointly with Song; whoever takes them shall hold them."
translations.idiomatic: He sent Sandu to the Song court with a reply: "As for the lands you ask for—we will attack together with Song, and whoever takes them shall keep them."

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑朔，遼使耶律奴哥等來議和。

translations.literal: On the first day guichou of the second month Liao envoys Yelü Nuge and others came to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the second month, guichou, Liao envoys led by Yelü Nuge came to sue for peace.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，孛堇迪古乃、婁室來見。

translations.literal: On xinyou Lijian Digunai and Loushi came to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Digunai and Loushi came to audience.

sentences.zh: 上以遼主近在中京，而敢輒來，皆杖之。

translations.literal: The emperor, because the Liao sovereign was recently at the Central Capital yet they dared come casually, had them all flogged.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Liao emperor was still at the Central Capital, the emperor had them all flogged for daring to come.

sentences.zh: 劾里保、雙古等言，鹹州都統斡魯古知遼主在中京而不進討，芻糧豐足而不以實聞，攻顯州時所獲生口財畜多自取。

translations.literal: Helibao, Shuanggu, and others reported that Xianzhou Commander-in-Chief Wulugu knew the Liao sovereign was at the Central Capital yet did not advance to attack, had abundant fodder and grain yet did not report the truth, and when attacking Xian Prefecture took many captives and livestock for himself.
translations.idiomatic: Helibao and Shuanggu reported that Wulugu, commander of Xianzhou, knew the Liao emperor was at the Central Capital yet failed to attack, had ample fodder yet lied about it, and kept much of the booty from Xian Prefecture for himself.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未朔，命闍哥代爲都統而鞫治之，斡魯古坐降謀克。

translations.literal: On the first day guiwei of the third month he ordered Gege to replace him as commander-in-chief and investigate and try him; Wulugu was demoted to the rank of mouke.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the third month, guiwei, he replaced Wulugu with Gege as commander and tried him. Wulugu was reduced to mouke.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遼使耶律奴哥以國書來。

translations.literal: On renchen the Liao envoy Yelü Nuge came with a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Liao envoy Yelü Nuge arrived with a state letter.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以婁室言黃龍府地僻且遠，宜重戍守，乃命合諸路謀克，以婁室爲萬戶鎮之。

translations.literal: On gengzi, because Loushi said Huanglong Prefecture's territory was remote and distant and should be heavily garrisoned, he ordered mouke from all routes combined and made Loushi ten-thousand-household commander to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, heeding Loushi's warning that Huanglong was remote and needed a strong garrison, he combined mouke from every circuit and made Loushi wanhu to hold it.

sentences.zh: 四月辛巳，遼使以國書來。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi of the fourth month a Liao envoy came with a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the fourth month a Liao envoy arrived with a state letter.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，命胡突袞如遼。

translations.literal: On bingshen of the fifth month he ordered Hutugun to go to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the fifth month he sent Hutugun to Liao.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，詔有司禁民淩虐典雇良人，及倍取贖直者。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin of the sixth month an edict ordered the relevant offices to forbid the people from abusing and oppressing contract-hired commoners, and those who took double redemption payments.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the sixth month an edict forbade abuse of contract laborers and charging double ransom.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遼通、祺、雙、遼等州八百餘戶來歸，命分置諸部，擇膏腴之地處之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu over eight hundred households from Tong, Qi, Shuang, Liao, and other prefectures came to submit; he ordered them placed separately among the divisions, choosing fertile land to settle them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu more than eight hundred households from Tong, Qi, Shuang, Liao, and other prefectures defected; they were distributed among the tribes on rich land.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，詔曰：「匹里水路完顏朮里古、渤海大家奴等六謀克貧乏之民，昔嘗給以官糧，置之漁獵之地。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei of the seventh month an edict said: "The poor people of six mouke of Pilishui Route—Wanyan Shuligu, Bohai Dajianu, and others—were formerly given official grain and placed in fishing and hunting lands.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the seventh month an edict read: "Among six mouke on the Pilishui route—including Wanyan Shuligu and Bohai Dajianu—poor households were once given government rations and settled on fishing and hunting grounds.

sentences.zh: 今曆日已久，不知登耗，可具其數以聞。

translations.literal: Now days have passed for a long time; we do not know gains and losses—compile their numbers and report.
translations.idiomatic: Long years have passed since then; compile full accounts of increase and decrease and report them.

sentences.zh: 」胡突袞還自遼，耶律奴哥復以國書來。

translations.literal: " Hutugun returned from Liao; Yelü Nuge again came with a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: " Hutugun returned from Liao, and Yelü Nuge again arrived with a state letter.

sentences.zh: 丙申，胡突袞如遼。

translations.literal: On bingshen Hutugun went to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Hutugun went to Liao again.

sentences.zh: 遼戶二百來歸，處之泰州。

translations.literal: Two hundred Liao households came to submit; they were placed at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred Liao households defected and were settled at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 詔遣阿里骨、李家奴、特里底招諭未降者。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Ali Gu, Li Jianu, and Telidi sent to summon and instruct those who had not yet submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Ali Gu, Li Jianu, and Telidi to win over those who had not yet surrendered.

sentences.zh: 仍詔達魯古部勃堇辭列：「凡降附新民，善爲存撫。

translations.literal: He further edicted Dailigu Division Bojin Cilie: "For all newly submitted people who submit, treat them well and succor them.
translations.idiomatic: He also told Cilie, bojin of the Dailigu division: "Treat every new defector with care and kindness.

sentences.zh: 來者各令從便安居，給以官糧，毋輒動擾。」

translations.literal: Let each who comes settle in convenience as they wish, give them official grain—do not lightly harass them."
translations.idiomatic: Let each settle where they choose, provide government rations, and do not harass them."

sentences.zh: 八月，胡突袞還自遼，耶律奴哥、突迭復以國書來。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Hutugun returned from Liao; Yelü Nuge and Tudie again came with state letters.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Hutugun returned from Liao, and Yelü Nuge and Tudie again arrived with state letters.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，詔曰：「國書詔令，宜選善屬文者爲之。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the ninth month an edict said: "State letters and edicts should be drafted by those skilled at literary composition.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the ninth month an edict declared: "State letters and edicts should be written by those skilled in prose.

sentences.zh: 其令所在訪求博學雄才之士。

translations.literal: Order the localities to seek out men of broad learning and heroic talent.
translations.idiomatic: Have every district search out men of broad learning and outstanding talent.

sentences.zh: 敦遣赴闕。」

translations.literal: Earnestly send them to the court."
translations.idiomatic: Send them promptly to court."

sentences.zh: 閏月庚戌朔，以降將霍石、韓慶和爲千戶。

translations.literal: On the first day gengxu of the intercalary month the surrendered generals Huo Shi and Han Qinghe were made wanhu.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the intercalary month, gengxu, the defectors Huo Shi and Han Qinghe were made wanhu.

sentences.zh: 九百奚部蕭寶、乙辛，北部訛里野，漢人王六兒、王伯龍，契丹特末、高從佑等，各率衆來降。

translations.literal: Xiao Bao and Yixin of the Jiubai Xi division, Eliye of the Northern Route, the Han Wang Liu'er and Wang Bolong, the Khitan Temei and Gao Congyou, and others each led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Bao and Yixin of the Jiubai Xi, Eliye of the Northern Route, the Han Wang Liu'er and Wang Bolong, the Khitan Temei and Gao Congyou, and others each surrendered with their followers.

sentences.zh: 遼耶律奴哥以國書來。

translations.literal: The Liao envoy Yelü Nuge came with a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao envoy Yelü Nuge arrived with a state letter.

sentences.zh: 十月癸未，以龍化州降者張應古、劉仲良爲千戶。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei of the tenth month the defectors from Longhua Prefecture Zhang Yinggu and Liu Zhongliang were made wanhu.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the tenth month Zhang Yinggu and Liu Zhongliang, who had surrendered from Longhua Prefecture, were made wanhu.

sentences.zh: 乙未，鹹州都統司言，漢人李孝功、渤海二哥率衆來降。

translations.literal: On yiwei the Xianzhou Commander's Office reported that the Han Li Xiaogong and the Bohai Erge each led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the Xianzhou command reported that Li Xiaogong, a Han, and Erge, a Bohai, had each surrendered with their followers.

sentences.zh: 命各以所部爲千戶。

translations.literal: He ordered each to be wanhu over his own following.
translations.idiomatic: Each was made wanhu over his own band.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，遣孛堇朮孛以定遼地諭高麗。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen of the twelfth month he dispatched Bojin Shubo to notify Goryeo of the settlement of Liao territory.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the twelfth month he sent Bojin Shubo to inform Goryeo that Liao territory had been settled.

sentences.zh: 耶律奴哥以國書來。

translations.literal: Yelü Nuge came with a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Nuge arrived with a state letter.

sentences.zh: 遼懿州節度使劉宏以戶三千並執遼候人來降，以爲千戶。

translations.literal: The Liao Yizhou Military Commissioner Liu Hong came to submit with three thousand households and captured Liao scouts; he was made wanhu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hong, Liao commissioner of Yizhou, defected with three thousand households and captive Liao scouts and was made wanhu.

sentences.zh: 川州寇二萬已降復叛，紇古烈照里擊破之。

translations.literal: Twenty thousand bandits of Chuan Prefecture who had submitted rebelled again; Hegulie Zhaoli defeated and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty thousand rebels at Chuan Prefecture who had surrendered rose again; Hegulie Zhaoli crushed them.

sentences.zh: 三年正月甲寅，東京人爲質者永吉等五人結衆叛。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin of the first month of year three Yongji and four others of the Eastern Capital who served as hostages banded together in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the first month of the third year Yongji and four other Eastern Capital hostages plotted rebellion together.

sentences.zh: 事覺，誅其首惡，余皆杖百，沒入在行家屬資產之半。

translations.literal: When the affair was discovered the ringleaders were executed; the rest were all flogged one hundred strokes, and half the property and assets of their households in the Eastern Capital were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: When the plot was exposed the ringleaders were executed; the rest were flogged a hundred strokes each, and half their families' property in the Eastern Capital was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 詔知東京事斡論，繼有犯者並如之。

translations.literal: An edict to Wo Lun, who managed Eastern Capital affairs, said that any who offended thereafter should be treated the same.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Wo Lun, administrator of the Eastern Capital, to punish future offenders in the same way.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔鱉古孛堇酬斡曰：「胡魯古、迭八合二部來送款，若等先時不無交惡，自今毋相侵擾。」

translations.literal: On bingchen an edict to Beyegu Bojin Chouwo said: "The Hulugu and Diebajie two divisions have come to offer submission; you and they were not without mutual enmity before—from now on do not harass one another."
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he told Chouwo, bojin of Beyegu: "The Hulugu and Diebajie divisions have submitted; though you had quarreled before, from now on do not trouble each other."

sentences.zh: 三月，耶律奴哥以國書來。

translations.literal: In the third month Yelü Nuge came with a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Yelü Nuge arrived with a state letter.

sentences.zh: 四月丙子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day bingzi of the fourth month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the fourth month, bingzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，詔咸州路都統司曰：「兵興以前，曷蘇館、回怕里與系遼籍、不系遼籍女直戶民，有犯罪流竄邊境或亡入于遼者，本皆吾民，遠在異境，朕甚憫之。

translations.literal: On the day renxu of the fifth month an edict to the Xianzhou Route Commander's Office said: "Before the raising of arms, Jurchen households of Hesuguan, Huipali, and those registered with Liao and not registered with Liao who committed crimes and were exiled to the borderlands or fled into Liao—all were originally our people, far off in alien territory; We greatly pity them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the fifth month an edict to the Xianzhou command read: "Before the war, Jurchen households of Hesuguan and Huipali—whether on the Liao register or not—who were exiled or fled into Liao were still our people; stranded in a foreign land, I pity them deeply.

sentences.zh: 今即議和，當行理索。

translations.literal: Now that peace is being discussed, reclamation should be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Peace talks are underway; their return must be arranged.

sentences.zh: 可明諭諸路千戶、謀克，遍與詢訪其官稱、名氏、地里，具錄以上。」

translations.literal: Clearly instruct the wanhu and mouke of all routes to inquire and investigate everywhere their official titles, names, and localities, compile full records and report upward."
translations.idiomatic: Tell every wanhu and mouke to search out their titles, names, and locations, record everything fully, and report upward."

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，遼遣太傳習泥烈等奉冊爾來，上擿冊文不合者數事復之。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao of the sixth month Liao dispatched Grand Mentor Xini Lie and others bearing investiture documents; the emperor picked out several matters in the document that did not accord and returned it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the sixth month Liao sent Grand Mentor Xini Lie with investiture documents; the emperor rejected several passages and sent them back.

sentences.zh: 散睹還自宋。

translations.literal: Sandu returned from Song.
translations.idiomatic: Sandu returned from Song.

sentences.zh: 宋使馬政及其子宏來聘。

translations.literal: The Song envoy Ma Zheng and his son Hong came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: The Song envoy Ma Zheng and his son Hong came on an embassy.

sentences.zh: 散睹受宋團練使，上怒，杖而奪之。

translations.literal: Sandu accepted the Song title of regimental training commissioner; the emperor was angry, had him flogged, and stripped it from him.
translations.idiomatic: Sandu had accepted a Song regimental command; the emperor had him flogged and stripped of the title.

sentences.zh: 宋使還，復遣孛堇辭列、魯等如宋。

translations.literal: When the Song envoys returned, he again dispatched Bojin Cilie, Lu, and others to go to Song.
translations.idiomatic: When the Song envoys departed, he sent Cilie, Lu, and others to Song in return.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，遼人楊詢卿、羅子韋各率衆來降，命各以所部爲謀克。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai of the seventh month the Liao men Yang Xunqing and Luo Ziwei each led their followers to submit; he ordered each to be mouke over his own following.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the seventh month Yang Xunqing and Luo Ziwei, both Liao men, each surrendered with their followers and were made mouke over their bands.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，頒女直字。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the eighth month Jurchen script was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the eighth month the Jurchen script was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 九月，以遼冊禮使失期，詔諸路軍過江屯駐。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, because the Liao investiture envoy missed the deadline, an edict ordered armies of all routes to cross the river and encamp.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, because the Liao investiture mission was overdue, troops from every route were ordered to cross the river and camp.

sentences.zh: 十一月，習泥烈等復以國書來。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Xini Lie and others again came with a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Xini Lie and others again arrived with a state letter.

sentences.zh: 曷懶甸長城，高麗增築三尺。

translations.literal: At the Hailan Great Wall, Goryeo added three feet to its height in construction.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo raised the Hailan Great Wall by three feet.

sentences.zh: 詔胡剌古、習顯慎固營壘。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Huligu and Xixian to carefully fortify camps and ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: Huligu and Xixian were ordered to strengthen their camps and defenses.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，辭列、曷魯還自宋。

translations.literal: In the second month of year four Cilie and Helu returned from Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year Cilie and Helu returned from Song.

sentences.zh: 宋使趙良嗣、王暉來議燕京、西京地。

translations.literal: The Song envoys Zhao Liangsi and Wang Hui came to negotiate the lands of Yanjing and the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Song envoys Zhao Liangsi and Wang Hui came to negotiate Yanjing and the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，上謂群臣曰：「遼人屢敗，遣使求成，惟飾虛辭，以爲緩師之計，當議進討。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen of the third month the emperor said to the ministers: "The Liao people have been repeatedly defeated yet send envoys seeking peace, only dressing up empty words as a plan to delay our armies—we should discuss advancing to attack.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the third month the emperor told his ministers: "Liao has lost again and again yet sends envoys seeking peace with empty words to stall our armies; we should discuss an advance.

sentences.zh: 其令咸州路統軍司治軍旅、修器械，具數以聞。

translations.literal: Order the Xianzhou Route Military Affairs Office to ready the armies, repair weapons, compile the numbers and report.
translations.idiomatic: Order the Xianzhou military office to ready troops, repair weapons, and report the numbers.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，詔咸州路都統司曰：「朕以遼國和議無成，將以四月二十五日進師。

translations.literal: " On xinyou an edict to the Xianzhou Route Commander's Office said: "We, because Liao peace talks have not succeeded, will advance the army on the twenty-fifth day of the fourth month.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinyou an edict to the Xianzhou command read: "Because peace talks with Liao have failed, I will advance the army on the twenty-fifth of the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 」令斜葛留兵一千鎮守，闍母以餘兵來會于渾河。

translations.literal: " He ordered Xiege to leave one thousand troops to garrison and defend; Zhanmu was to bring the remaining troops to rendezvous at the Hun River.
translations.idiomatic: " Xiege was left with a thousand men to garrison the post; Zhanmu was to bring the rest to join at the Hun River.

sentences.zh: 遼習泥烈以國書來。

translations.literal: The Liao envoy Xini Lie came with a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao envoy Xini Lie arrived with a state letter.

sentences.zh: 四月乙未，上自將伐遼。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the fourth month the emperor personally led troops to attack Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the fourth month the emperor personally led an attack on Liao.

sentences.zh: 以遼使習泥烈、宋使趙良嗣等從行。

translations.literal: He had the Liao envoy Xini Lie, the Song envoy Zhao Liangsi, and others accompany the march.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao envoy Xini Lie, the Song envoy Zhao Liangsi, and others accompanied the campaign.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰，次渾河西，使宗雄先趨上京，遣降者馬乙持詔諭城中。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen of the fifth month he halted west of the Hun River, sent Zongxiong ahead in haste toward the Supreme Capital, and dispatched the defector Ma Yi bearing an edict to announce terms within the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the fifth month he camped west of the Hun River, sent Zongxiong ahead toward the Supreme Capital, and had the defector Ma Yi carry an edict into the city.

sentences.zh: 壬子，至上京，詔官民曰：「遼主失道，上下同怨。

translations.literal: On renzi he reached the Supreme Capital and edicted the officials and people: "The Liao sovereign has lost the Way; above and below share the same resentment.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he reached the Supreme Capital and proclaimed to officials and people: "The Liao ruler has lost the Way, and high and low alike resent him.

sentences.zh: 朕興兵以來，所過城邑負固不服者即攻拔之，降者撫恤之，汝等必聞之矣。

translations.literal: Since We raised armies, in every city and town passed through those who stubbornly held out and would not submit We at once attacked and took; those who submitted We treated and succored—you must have heard of this.
translations.idiomatic: Since I took the field, every city that resisted has been taken by force and every city that surrendered has been treated kindly—you must have heard as much.

sentences.zh: 今爾國和好之事，反覆見欺，朕不欲天下生靈久罹塗炭，遂決策進討。

translations.literal: Now in matters of friendship and peace with your state We have been repeatedly deceived; We do not wish the living beings under Heaven long to suffer smeared in charcoal, and so have decided to advance and attack.
translations.idiomatic: Your state's peace overtures have repeatedly proved false; unwilling to let the people suffer war any longer, I have resolved to advance.

sentences.zh: 比遣宗雄等相繼招諭，尚不聽從。

translations.literal: Recently We dispatched Zongxiong and others in succession to summon and instruct—you still would not heed.
translations.idiomatic: I sent Zongxiong and others in succession to offer terms, yet you still would not listen.

sentences.zh: 今若攻之，則城破矣！

translations.literal: If We attack now, the city will be broken!
translations.idiomatic: If I attack now, the city will fall!

sentences.zh: 重以吊伐之義，不欲殘民，故開示明詔，諭以禍福，其審圖之。

translations.literal: Weighing again the principle of a punitive expedition, not wishing to harm the people, We therefore open and display this clear edict, instruct you in fortune and disaster—consider it carefully.
translations.idiomatic: Out of pity for the people and in the name of a just punitive expedition, I offer this open proclamation of blessing and ruin—weigh it carefully.

sentences.zh: 」上京人恃禦備儲蓄爲固守計。

translations.literal: " The people of the Supreme Capital relied on defenses, preparations, and stores as their plan for stubborn defense.
translations.idiomatic: " The people of the Supreme Capital counted on fortifications and stored supplies for a stubborn defense.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，亟命進攻。

translations.literal: On jiayin he urgently ordered an advance to attack.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he urgently ordered the assault.

sentences.zh: 上謂習泥烈、趙良嗣等曰：「汝可觀吾用兵，以卜去就。

translations.literal: The emperor said to Xini Lie, Zhao Liangsi, and others: "You may observe Our use of troops and thereby divine whether to stay or go.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told Xini Lie, Zhao Liangsi, and the others: "Watch how I use my armies and judge for yourselves whether to stay or go.

sentences.zh: 」上親臨城，督將士諸軍鼓噪而進。

translations.literal: " The emperor personally came to the wall, directed the officers and soldiers of all armies to advance with drums and shouts.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor went in person to the wall and directed the armies forward with drums and battle cries.

sentences.zh: 自旦及巳，闍母以麾下先登，克其外城，留守撻不野以城降。

translations.literal: From dawn until the si hour Zhanmu with his personal troops scaled first, took the outer city, and the garrison commander Tabuye surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: From dawn until si Zhanmu's vanguard scaled the walls first and took the outer city; the garrison commander Tabuye surrendered.

sentences.zh: 趙良嗣等奉觴爲壽，皆稱萬歲。

translations.literal: Zhao Liangsi and others raised cups to wish long life; all cried ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Liangsi and the others raised cups to toast long life; all cried "Ten thousand years!"

sentences.zh: 是日，赦上京官民。

translations.literal: That day he pardoned the officials and people of the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: That day he pardoned the officials and people of the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 詔諭遼副統餘睹。

translations.literal: An edict was sent to instruct Liao Deputy Commander Yuduo.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was sent to the Liao deputy commander Yuduo.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，次沃黑河。

translations.literal: On renxu he halted at the Wohei River.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he halted at the Wohei River.

sentences.zh: 宗幹率群臣諫曰：「地遠時暑，軍馬罷乏，若深入敵境，糧饋乏絕，恐有後艱。

translations.literal: Zonggan led the ministers in remonstrance, saying: "The ground is far and the season hot; armies and horses are exhausted and weary—if We penetrate deep into enemy territory and grain supplies are cut off, We fear later hardship.
translations.idiomatic: Zonggan and the ministers remonstrated: "The land is distant and the season hot; horses and troops are exhausted. If we push deep into enemy country and supplies fail, grave trouble may follow.

sentences.zh: 」上從之，乃班師，命分兵攻慶州。

translations.literal: " The emperor assented, then withdrew the army, and ordered detachments to attack Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed, withdrew the army, and ordered detached forces to attack Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 余睹襲闍母于遼河，完顏背答、烏塔等戰卻之，完顏特虎死焉。

translations.literal: Yuduo attacked Zhanmu at the Liao River; Wanyan Beidaa, Wuta, and others fought and repelled him; Wanyan Tehu died in the action.
translations.idiomatic: Yuduo ambushed Zhanmu at the Liao River; Wanyan Beidaa, Wuta, and others drove him back, and Wanyan Tehu was killed.

sentences.zh: 七月癸卯，上至自伐遼。

translations.literal: On the day guimao of the seventh month the emperor returned from attacking Liao.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the seventh month the emperor returned from the campaign against Liao.

sentences.zh: 九月，燭隈水部實里古達等殺孛堇酬斡、僕忽得以叛。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Shiliguda and others of the Zhuzui Shui Division killed Bojin Chouwo and Puhuyi and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Shiliguda and others of the Zhuzui Shui division killed Bojin Chouwo and Puhuyi and rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 十月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day wuchen of the tenth month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the tenth month, wuchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命斡魯分胡剌古、烏春之兵以討實里古達。

translations.literal: On wuyin he ordered Wolu to divide the troops of Huligu and Wuchun to suppress Shiliguda.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he ordered Wolu to detach Huligu's and Wuchun's forces to suppress Shiliguda.

sentences.zh: 十一月，東京留守司乞本京官民質子增數番代，上不許，曰：「諸質子已各受田廬，若復番代，則往來動搖，可並仍舊。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Eastern Capital Commissary Office requested that the hostage sons of officials and people of the capital be increased in number and rotated in shifts; the emperor did not permit it, saying: "The various hostage sons have each already received fields and dwellings—if they are rotated again in shifts, coming and going will unsettle them; all may remain as before."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Eastern Capital commissary asked to increase hostage sons and rotate them more often; the emperor refused, saying: "The hostages already have fields and houses; further rotation would unsettle them—let the arrangement stand."

sentences.zh: 十二月，宋復使馬政來請西京之地。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Song again sent Ma Zheng to request the land of the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Song again sent Ma Zheng to ask for the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月，斡魯敗實里古達于合撻剌山，誅首惡四人，餘悉撫定。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of year five Wolu defeated Shiliguda at Hetala Mountain, executed four ringleaders, and pacified all the rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year Wolu defeated Shiliguda at Mount Hetala, executed four ringleaders, and pacified the rest.

sentences.zh: 二月，遣昱及宗雄分諸路猛安謀克之民萬戶屯泰州，以婆盧火統之，賜耕牛五十。

translations.literal: In the second month he dispatched Yu and Zongxiong to divide ten thousand households of the people of meng'an and mouke from all routes to garrison Taizhou, put Boluo in overall command, and granted fifty draft oxen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he sent Yu and Zongxiong to settle ten thousand households from the meng'an and mouke of every route at Taizhou under Boluo's command, granting fifty draft oxen.

sentences.zh: 四月乙丑朔，宗翰請伐遼，詔諸路預戒軍事。

translations.literal: On the first day yichou of the fourth month Zonghan requested to attack Liao; an edict ordered all routes to warn and prepare militarily in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the fourth month, yichou, Zonghan asked to campaign against Liao; every route was ordered to prepare for war.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，餘睹與其將吏來見。

translations.literal: On the day guisi of the sixth month Yuduo came to audience with his generals and officials.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the sixth month Yuduo came to audience with his officers.

sentences.zh: 丙申，千戶胡離答坐擅署部人爲蒲里衍，杖一百，罷之。

translations.literal: On bingshen Wanhu Hulida, on account of appointing people of his division as puliyan on his own authority, was flogged one hundred strokes and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wanhu Hulida was flogged a hundred strokes and dismissed for appointing men of his band as puliyan without authorization.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔諳版勃極烈吳乞買貳國政。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict made Anban Bojilie Wuqimai second in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Anban Bojilie Wuqimai was named to assist in governing the state.

sentences.zh: 以昊勃極烈斜也爲忽魯勃極烈，蒲家奴爲昊勃極烈，宗翰爲移賚勃極烈。

translations.literal: Hao Bojilie Xieye was made Hulubojilie, Pujianu was made Hao Bojilie, and Zonghan was made Yisai Bojilie.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Bojilie Xieye became Hulubojilie, Pujianu became Hao Bojilie, and Zonghan became Yisai Bojilie.

sentences.zh: 七月庚辰，詔鹹州都統司曰：「自餘睹來，灼見遼國事宜，已決議親征，其治軍以俟師期。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen of the seventh month an edict to the Xianzhou Commander's Office said: "Since Yuduo came, Liao affairs have been clearly seen; a personal expedition has already been decided—ready the armies to await the day of marching.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the seventh month an edict to the Xianzhou command read: "Since Yuduo's arrival the situation in Liao is clear; I have decided on a personal campaign—ready your armies for the appointed day.

sentences.zh: 」尋以連雨罷親征。

translations.literal: " Soon afterward, because of continuous rain, the personal expedition was cancelled.
translations.idiomatic: " Soon afterward continuous rain cancelled the personal campaign.

sentences.zh: 命昊勃極烈昱爲都統，稱賚勃極烈宗翰副之，帥師而西。

translations.literal: He ordered Hao Bojilie Yu to be commander-in-chief, with Yisai Bojilie Zonghan as deputy, to command the army westward.
translations.idiomatic: Hao Bojilie Yu was made overall commander with Yisai Bojilie Zonghan as his deputy, and they led the army west.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，以忽魯勃極烈杲爲內外諸軍都統，以昱、宗翰、宗幹、宗望、宗盤等副之。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou of the twelfth month Hulubojilie Gao was made commander-in-chief of all armies inner and outer, with Yu, Zonghan, Zonggan, Zongwang, Zongpan, and others as deputies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the twelfth month Hulubojilie Gao was made commander-in-chief of all armies at home and abroad, with Yu, Zonghan, Zonggan, Zongwang, Zongpan, and others as deputies.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔曰：「遼政不綱，人神共棄。

translations.literal: On jiachen an edict said: "Liao government lacks order; men and spirits together have abandoned it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen an edict declared: "Liao's government has lost all discipline; gods and men alike have forsaken it.

sentences.zh: 今欲中外一統，故命汝率大軍以行討伐。

translations.literal: Now We wish to unify inner and outer as one; therefore We order you to lead a great army to carry out punitive attack.
translations.idiomatic: I mean to unify the realm; therefore I order you to lead a great army on punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 爾其慎重兵事，擇用善謀，賞罰必行，糧餉必繼，勿擾降服，勿縱俘掠，見可而進，無淹師期。

translations.literal: You must be careful in military affairs, choose and employ good counsel, rewards and punishments must be carried out, grain and pay must continue, do not harass those who submit, do not allow captive looting, advance when you see opportunity, do not delay the army's deadline.
translations.idiomatic: Be careful in war, choose good counsel, enforce reward and punishment, keep supplies flowing, do not trouble the surrendered, do not allow looting, advance when the moment is ripe, and miss no deadline.

sentences.zh: 事有從權，毋須申稟。

translations.literal: When affairs require acting on discretion, there is no need to report and request permission.
translations.idiomatic: Where discretion is required, you need not report in advance.

sentences.zh: 」戊申，詔曰：「若克中京，所得禮樂儀仗圖書文籍，並先次津發赴闕。」

translations.literal: " On wushen an edict said: "If the Central Capital is taken, all ritual objects, music, ceremonial regalia, maps, books, and documents obtained shall first be dispatched by relays to the court."
translations.idiomatic: " On wushen an edict ordered: "If the Central Capital falls, send all ritual regalia, instruments, maps, books, and records to court by relay at once."

sentences.zh: 六年正月癸酉，都統杲克高、恩、回紇三城。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou of the first month of year six Commander-in-Chief Gao took the three cities of Gao, En, and Huihe.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the first month of the sixth year Commander Gao took the three cities of Gao, En, and Huihe.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，取中京，遂下澤州。

translations.literal: On yihai he took the Central Capital, and then Ze Prefecture submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Central Capital was taken, and Ze Prefecture submitted.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day gengyin of the second month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the second month, gengyin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己亥，宗翰等敗遼奚王霞末于北安州，降。

translations.literal: On jihai Zonghan and others defeated the Liao Prince of Xi Xiamo at Beian Prefecture; he submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zonghan and others defeated the Liao Prince of Xi, Xiamo, at Beian Prefecture, and he surrendered.

sentences.zh: 奚部西節度使訛里剌以本部降。

translations.literal: The Western Military Commissioner of the Xi Division Elila submitted with his original division.
translations.idiomatic: Elila, Western military commissioner of the Xi division, surrendered with his entire band.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，都統杲遣使來奏捷，並獻所獲貨寶。

translations.literal: On renyin Commander-in-Chief Gao sent envoys to report victory, and together presented captured goods and treasures.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Commander Gao sent envoys to report victory and present captured goods and treasure.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「汝等提兵于外，克副所任，攻下城邑，撫安人民，朕甚嘉之。

translations.literal: An edict said: "You and others have led troops abroad, fully fulfilled your commission, taken cities, and pacified the people—We greatly commend this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "You have led your army abroad, fulfilled your charge, taken cities, and settled the people—I commend you for it.

sentences.zh: 所言分遣將士招降山前諸部，計悉已撫定，續遣來報。

translations.literal: What you reported about dispatching generals and soldiers to summon submission from the various divisions before the mountains—I reckon all have already been pacified; continue to send reports.
translations.idiomatic: The detachments you sent to win over the tribes south of the mountains are, I trust, all pacified—keep the reports coming.

sentences.zh: 山后若未可往，即營田牧馬，俟及秋成，乃圖大舉。

translations.literal: If the lands behind the mountains cannot yet be entered, then establish fields and herd horses, wait until the autumn harvest is complete, and then plan a major campaign.
translations.idiomatic: If you cannot yet enter the lands beyond the mountains, farm and pasture there until the autumn harvest, then plan the main assault.

sentences.zh: 更當熟議，見可則行。

translations.literal: You must further deliberate carefully; act when you see opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: Debate the matter thoroughly and move only when the moment is ripe.

sentences.zh: 如欲益兵，具數來上，不可恃一戰之勝，輒有弛慢。

translations.literal: If you wish to increase troops, report the numbers; you must not rely on one battle's victory and then become lax.
translations.idiomatic: If you need reinforcements, report the numbers—but do not grow slack after a single victory.

sentences.zh: 新降附者當善撫存。

translations.literal: Those newly submitted must be well comforted and preserved.
translations.idiomatic: Treat those who have newly submitted with care.

sentences.zh: 宣諭將士，使知朕意。

translations.literal: Proclaim this to the generals and soldiers so they know Our intent.
translations.idiomatic: Make my intent known to every officer and soldier.

sentences.zh: 」宗翰駐北安，遣希尹等略地，獲遼護衛耶律習泥烈，知遼主獵鴛鴦濼，以其子晉王賢而有人望，惡而殺之，衆益離心。

translations.literal: " Zonghan encamped at Bei'an, dispatched Xiyin and others to raid territory, captured Liao guard Yelü Xinilie, and learned that the Liao ruler was hunting at Yuanyang Marsh; because his son the Prince of Jin was worthy and had popular esteem, he hated and killed him—the masses grew ever more alienated in heart.
translations.idiomatic: " Zonghan halted at Bei'an and sent Xiyin and others to sweep the countryside. They captured the Liao guardsman Yelü Xinilie and learned that the Liao emperor was hunting at Yuanyang Marsh. Because his son, the Prince of Jin, was capable and admired by the people, he had hated him and put him to death—the court grew ever more estranged.

sentences.zh: 雖有西北、西南兩路兵馬，皆羸弱。

translations.literal: Although there were troops of the northwest and southwest two routes, all were weak and feeble.
translations.idiomatic: The northwest and southwest armies existed, but both were feeble.

sentences.zh: 遂遣耨碗溫都等報都統杲進兵襲之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he dispatched Nuwandu and others to report to Commander-in-Chief Gao to advance troops and attack him.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Nuwandu and others to urge Commander Gao to march and strike.

sentences.zh: 三月，都統杲出青嶺，宗翰出瓢嶺，追遼主于鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: In the third month Commander-in-Chief Gao issued through Qing Ridge, Zonghan issued through Piao Ridge, and pursued the Liao ruler at Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Commander Gao marched out through Qing Ridge and Zonghan through Piao Ridge, pursuing the Liao emperor to Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 遼主奔西京。

translations.literal: The Liao ruler fled to the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao emperor fled to the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 宗翰復追至白水濼，不及，獲其貨寶。

translations.literal: Zonghan again pursued to Baishui Marsh, did not overtake him, and obtained his goods and treasures.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan pressed on to Baishui Marsh but could not overtake him; he seized the emperor's baggage of goods and treasure.

sentences.zh: 己巳，至西京。

translations.literal: On jisi they reached the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi they reached the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，西京降。

translations.literal: On renshen the Western Capital submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Western Capital surrendered.

sentences.zh: 希尹追遼主于乙室部，不及。

translations.literal: Xiyin pursued the Liao ruler in the Yishi Division, and did not overtake him.
translations.idiomatic: Xiyin pursued the Liao emperor into the Yishi division but could not catch him.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，西京復叛。

translations.literal: On yihai the Western Capital rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Western Capital rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 四月辛卯，復取西京。

translations.literal: On xinmao of the fourth month they recaptured the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the fourth month the Western Capital was retaken.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣徒單吳甲、高慶裔如宋。

translations.literal: On renchen he dispatched Tudi Wujia and Gao Qingyi to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he sent Tudi Wujia and Gao Qingyi as envoys to Song.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，都統杲自西京趨白水濼，昊勃極烈昱襲毗室部于鐵呂川，爲敵所敗。

translations.literal: On wuxu Commander-in-Chief Gao hastened from the Western Capital toward Baishui Marsh; Hao Bojilie Yu attacked the Pishi Division at Tielü River and was defeated by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Commander Gao pressed from the Western Capital toward Baishui Marsh. Hao Bojilie Yu struck the Pishi division at the Tielü River and was beaten by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 還會察剌兵，追至黃水北，大破之。

translations.literal: Returning he joined Chala's troops, pursued to north of the Yellow River, and routed them greatly.
translations.idiomatic: He regrouped with Chala's forces, pursued them to the north bank of the Huang River, and broke them utterly.

sentences.zh: 耶律坦招徠西南諸部，西至夏，其招討使耶律佛頂降。

translations.literal: Yelü Tan summoned the southwest various divisions, westward as far as Xia; his pacification commissioner Yelü Foding submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Tan rallied the tribes of the southwest as far west as Xia; his pacification commissioner Yelü Foding surrendered.

sentences.zh: 金肅、西平二郡漢軍四千餘人叛去，耶律坦等襲取之。

translations.literal: More than four thousand Han troops of the two prefectures Jinsu and Xiping rebelled and fled; Yelü Tan and others attacked and recovered them.
translations.idiomatic: More than four thousand Han soldiers of Jinsu and Xiping prefectures broke away; Yelü Tan and others overtook and retook them.

sentences.zh: 闍母、婁室招降天德、雲內、甯邊、東勝等州，獲阿疏而還。

translations.literal: Zhanmu and Loushi summoned submission from the prefectures Tiande, Yunnei, Ningbian, Dongsheng, and others, captured Ashu, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zhanmu and Loushi won over Tiande, Yunnei, Ningbian, Dongsheng, and other prefectures, captured Ashu, and returned.

sentences.zh: 是時，山西城邑諸部雖降，人心未固，遼主保陰山，耶律捍里在燕京，都統杲遣宗望入奏，請上臨軍。

translations.literal: At this time although the city settlements and various divisions of Shanxi had submitted, men's hearts were not yet firm; the Liao ruler held the Yin Mountains, Yelü Hanli was at Yan Capital; Commander-in-Chief Gao dispatched Zongwang to enter and report, requesting that the emperor come in person to the army.
translations.idiomatic: By then the cities and tribes of western Shanxi had submitted, but loyalty was not yet secure. The Liao emperor held the Yin Mountains; Yelü Hanli was at Yanjing. Commander Gao sent Zongwang to court to ask the emperor to take command in the field.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，宗望來奏捷，百官入賀，賜宴歡甚。

translations.literal: On xinyou of the fifth month Zongwang came to report victory; the hundred officials entered to congratulate; a banquet was granted and joy was very great.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the fifth month Zongwang brought word of victory; the officials came to congratulate and were feasted with great rejoicing.

sentences.zh: 先是，獲遼樞密使得里底、節度使和尚、雅里斯、餘里野等，都統杲使阿鄰護送赴闕。

translations.literal: Earlier, having captured Liao privy councilor Delidi, military commissioners Heshang, Yalisi, Yuliye, and others, Commander-in-Chief Gao had Ailin escort them to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Commander Gao had captured the Liao privy councilor Delidi and the commissioners Heshang, Yalisi, Yuliye, and others, and sent Ailin to escort them to court.

sentences.zh: 得里底道亡，阿鄰坐誅。

translations.literal: Delidi died on the road in flight; Ailin was punished with execution.
translations.idiomatic: Delidi died en route; Ailin was executed for the failure.

sentences.zh: 耶律捍里遣使請罷兵。

translations.literal: Yelü Hanli dispatched envoys requesting cessation of hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Hanli sent envoys asking for peace.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，使楊勉以書諭捍里，使之降。

translations.literal: On wuyin he sent Yang Mian with a letter to instruct Hanli, causing him to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he dispatched Yang Mian with a letter urging Hanli to surrender.

sentences.zh: 謀葛失遣其子菹泥刮失貢方物。

translations.literal: Mogeshi sent his son Zuaninigua to present local products in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Mogeshi sent his son Zuaninigua to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子朔，上親征遼，發自上京。

translations.literal: On the first day wuzi of the sixth month the emperor personally campaigned against Liao, setting out from the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the sixth month, wuzi, the emperor personally marched against Liao, leaving the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 諳班勃極烈吳乞買監國。

translations.literal: Anban Bojilie Wuqimai supervised the state.
translations.idiomatic: Anban Bojilie Wuqimai was left to govern in his absence.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔諭上京官民曰：「朕順天吊伐，已定三京，但以遼主未獲，兵不能已。

translations.literal: On xinhai an edict instructed the officials and people of the Supreme Capital, saying: "We follow Heaven in punitive expedition; the three capitals are already settled, but because the Liao ruler has not been captured, the army cannot cease.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict to the officials and people of the Supreme Capital read: "I march with Heaven's mandate; the three capitals are secured, but until the Liao emperor is taken the war cannot end.

sentences.zh: 今者親征，欲由上京路進，恐撫定新民，驚疑失業，已出自篤密呂。

translations.literal: Now in this personal expedition, We wished to advance by the Supreme Capital route, fearing that pacifying the newly settled people would alarm and unsettle them and cause loss of livelihood; We have already set out from Dumilü.
translations.idiomatic: On this campaign I had meant to march by the Supreme Capital road, but feared unsettling the newly pacified population; I have therefore set out from Dumilü instead.

sentences.zh: 其先降後叛逃入險阻者，詔後出首，悉免其罪。

translations.literal: Those who first submitted then rebelled and fled into perilous passes—an edict announced that those who afterward come forward shall all have their crimes remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Those who submitted and then rebelled and fled into the hills may surrender afterward with full amnesty.

sentences.zh: 若猶拒命，孥戮無赦。」

translations.literal: If they still resist commands, wives and children shall be slaughtered without pardon."
translations.idiomatic: Whoever still resists—his family shall be put to the sword without mercy."

sentences.zh: 是月，耶律捍里卒。

translations.literal: In this month Yelü Hanli died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yelü Hanli died.

sentences.zh: 斡魯、婁室敗夏人于野穀。

translations.literal: Wolu and Loushi defeated the Xia people at Yegu.
translations.idiomatic: Wolu and Loushi defeated the Tangut at Wild Valley.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子，詔諸將無得遠迎，以廢軍務。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi of the seventh month an edict ordered that generals must not go far to welcome, lest military affairs be neglected.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the seventh month an edict forbade officers from riding out far to welcome the emperor, lest camp duties suffer.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，上京漢人毛八十率二千餘戶降，因命領之。

translations.literal: On yichou Mao Bashi, a Han man of the Supreme Capital, led more than two thousand households to submit; thereupon he was ordered to command them.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Mao Bashi, a Han man of the Supreme Capital, brought more than two thousand households to surrender; the emperor put him in charge of them.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以斡荅剌招降者衆，命領八千戶，以忽薛副之。

translations.literal: On bingyin, because Wodala had summoned many to submit, he was ordered to command eight thousand households, with Huxue as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, since Wodala had won over many tribes, he was given command of eight thousand households with Huxue as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 壬午，希尹以阿疏見杖而釋之。

translations.literal: On renwu Xiyin had Ashu beaten with the cudgel and then released him.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Xiyin had Ashu flogged and then set free.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，次鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: On jichou of the eighth month they halted at Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the eighth month the army halted at Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 都統杲率官屬來見。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Gao led his official subordinates to come and pay audience.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Gao came with his staff to pay audience.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上追遼主于大魚濼。

translations.literal: On guisi the emperor pursued the Liao ruler at Dayu Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the emperor pursued the Liao emperor to Dayu Marsh.

sentences.zh: 昱、宗望追及遼主于石輦鐸，與戰，敗之，遼主遁。

translations.literal: Yu and Zongwang overtook the Liao ruler at Shinian Duo, joined battle, defeated him, and the Liao ruler fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yu and Zongwang caught the Liao emperor at Shinian Duo, fought him, routed his force, and the emperor fled.

sentences.zh: 己亥，次居延北。

translations.literal: On jihai they halted north of Juyan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the army camped north of Juyan.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，中京將完顏渾黜敗契丹、奚、漢六萬于高州，孛堇麻吉死之。

translations.literal: On xinchou the Central Capital general Wanyan Hunchu defeated sixty thousand Khitan, Xi, and Han at Gaozhou; Bojin Maji died in the action.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Central Capital general Wanyan Hunchu broke sixty thousand Khitan, Xi, and Han troops at Gaozhou; Bojin Maji was killed.

sentences.zh: 得里得滿部降。

translations.literal: The Delideman Division submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Delideman division surrendered.

sentences.zh: 昱、宗望追遼主于烏里質鐸，不及。

translations.literal: Yu and Zongwang pursued the Liao ruler at Wulizhi Duo but did not overtake him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu and Zongwang pursued the Liao emperor to Wulizhi Duo but could not overtake him.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，次草濼。

translations.literal: On gengshen of the ninth month they halted at Cao Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the ninth month the army halted at Cao Marsh.

sentences.zh: 闍母平中京部族之先叛者，及招撫沿海郡縣。

translations.literal: Zhanmu pacified those who had rebelled first among the Central Capital division tribes, and also summoned and comforted the coastal commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Zhanmu subdued the rebel Central Capital tribes and pacified the coastal prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 節度使耶律慎思領諸部入內地。

translations.literal: Military Commissioner Yelü Shensi led the various divisions into the inner territories.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Yelü Shensi led his tribes into the interior.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔六部奚曰：「汝等既降復叛，扇誘衆心，罪在不赦。

translations.literal: On yichou an edict to the Six Xi Divisions said: "You have submitted and then rebelled again, inciting and swaying the hearts of the masses—the crime admits no pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou an edict to the Six Xi divisions read: "You submitted and rebelled again, stirring the people—a crime that would not be forgiven.

sentences.zh: 尚以歸附日淺，恐綏懷之道有所未孚，故復令招諭。

translations.literal: Still, because the days since submission are brief, fearing that the way of soothing attachment has not yet fully won trust, We therefore again order summoning and instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Yet because your submission is recent and my policy of clemency may not yet have won your trust, I offer you one more summons.

sentences.zh: 若能速降，當釋其罪，官皆仍舊。

translations.literal: If you can quickly submit, We shall release your crimes and your offices shall all remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: Surrender at once and your crimes will be pardoned and your ranks restored.

sentences.zh: 」歸化州降。

translations.literal: " Guihuazhou submitted.
translations.idiomatic: " Guihua Prefecture surrendered.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，次歸化州。

translations.literal: On wuchen they halted at Guihua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the army halted at Guihua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，宗雄薨。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Zongxiong died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Zongxiong died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，奉聖州降。

translations.literal: On dingchou Fengsheng Prefecture submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Fengsheng Prefecture surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十月丙戌朔，次奉聖州。

translations.literal: On the first day bingxu of the tenth month they halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the tenth month, bingxu, the army halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔曰；

translations.literal: An edict said;
translations.idiomatic: An edict read;

sentences.zh: 「朕屢敕將臣，安輯懷附，無或侵擾。

translations.literal: "We have repeatedly charged the generals and ministers to settle and comfort those who attach themselves, that none should harass or disturb.
translations.idiomatic: "I have again and again ordered my generals to settle and protect those who submit—not to harass them.

sentences.zh: 然愚民無知，尚多逃匿山林，即欲加兵，深所不忍。

translations.literal: Yet foolish people lack understanding; many still hide and flee in mountains and forests—if We were immediately to send troops against them, it is what We deeply cannot bear.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the ignorant commoners still flee into the hills; to send troops after them is more than I can bear.

sentences.zh: 今其逃散人民，罪無輕重，鹹與矜免。

translations.literal: Now as for the scattered fugitive people, crimes great or small are all alike granted mercy and remission.
translations.idiomatic: All fugitives, whatever their offense, are hereby pardoned.

sentences.zh: 有能率衆歸附者，授之世官。

translations.literal: Those who can lead masses to attach and submit shall be granted hereditary offices.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever brings his people in shall receive a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 或奴婢先其主降，並釋爲良。

translations.literal: Or if slaves and servants submit before their masters, all shall be released as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Slaves who surrender before their masters shall be freed as commoners.

sentences.zh: 其佈告之，使諭朕意。

translations.literal: Proclaim this and make them understand Our intent.
translations.idiomatic: Post this proclamation so that all may know my will.

sentences.zh: 」蔚州降。

translations.literal: " Weizhou submitted.
translations.idiomatic: " Weizhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，餘睹等遣蔚州降臣翟昭彥、徐興、田慶來見。

translations.literal: On gengyin Yuduo and others dispatched the Weizhou submitted ministers Zhai Zhaoyan, Xu Xing, and Tian Qing to come and pay audience.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Yuduo sent the surrendered Weizhou officers Zhai Zhaoyan, Xu Xing, and Tian Qing to audience.

sentences.zh: 命昭彥、慶皆爲刺史，興爲團練使。

translations.literal: He ordered Zhaoyan and Qing each to be prefect; Xing to be regiment-training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaoyan and Qing were made prefects; Xing was made regiment-training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「比以幽、薊一方招之不服，今欲帥師以往，故先安撫山西諸部。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Recently because the region of You and Ji was summoned yet would not submit, now We wish to lead the army thither; therefore We first soothe and settle the various divisions of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: An edict read: "Because You and Ji have not submitted, I mean to lead the army there myself; I have first sought to settle the tribes of western Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 汝等既已懷服，宜加撫存。

translations.literal: You have already submitted in heart; you should receive added comfort and preservation.
translations.idiomatic: You who have already submitted in good faith should be treated with still greater care.

sentences.zh: 官民未附已前，罪無輕重及系官逋負，皆與釋免，諸官各遷敘之。

translations.literal: Before officials and people submitted, crimes great or small and official arrears in debt are all remitted and released; each official is promoted in rank accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: All offenses and debts to the state incurred before submission, great or small, are forgiven, and every officer shall retain or advance in rank.

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，蔚州翟昭產、田慶殺知州事蕭觀寧等以叛。

translations.literal: " On dingyou Zhai Zhaocan and Tian Qing of Weizhou killed the prefectural administrator Xiao Guanning and others and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingyou Zhai Zhaocan and Tian Qing of Weizhou killed the acting prefect Xiao Guanning and others and rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復降。

translations.literal: On bingwu they submitted again.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu they surrendered again.

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔諭燕京官民，王師所至，降者赦其罪，官皆仍舊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month an edict instructed the officials and people of Yan Capital: wherever the royal army arrives, those who submit shall have their crimes pardoned and offices shall all remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month an edict to the officials and people of Yanjing declared: wherever the imperial army comes, those who surrender shall be pardoned and keep their offices.

sentences.zh: 十二月，上伐燕京。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the emperor attacked Yan Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the emperor marched on Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 宗望率兵七千先之，迪古乃出得勝口，銀朮哥出居庸關，婁室爲左翼，婆盧火爲右翼，取居庸關。

translations.literal: Zongwang led seven thousand troops ahead; Digunai issued through Desheng Pass, Yinzhuge issued through Juyong Pass; Loushi was left wing, Boluo was right wing—they took Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang led seven thousand men ahead. Digunai marched out through Desheng Pass and Yinzhuge through Juyong Pass; Loushi commanded the left wing and Boluo the right, and they seized Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，次媯州。

translations.literal: On dinghai they halted at Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the army halted at Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，次居庸關。

translations.literal: On wuzi they halted at Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the army halted at Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，遼統軍都監高六等來送款。

translations.literal: On gengyin Liao unified-army director Gao Liu and others came to offer submission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Liao unified-army director Gao Liu and others came to submit.

sentences.zh: 上至燕京，入自南門，使銀朮哥、婁室陣于城上，乃次于城南。

translations.literal: The emperor reached Yan Capital, entered by the south gate, had Yinzhuge and Loushi form ranks on the city wall, and then halted south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reached Yanjing, entered by the south gate, posted Yinzhuge and Loushi on the walls, and encamped south of the city.

sentences.zh: 遼知樞密院左企弓、虞仲文，樞密使曹勇義，副使張彥忠，參知政事康公弼，僉書劉彥宗奉表降。

translations.literal: Liao privy council director Zuo Qigong and Yu Zhongwen, privy council commissioner Cao Yongyi, vice commissioner Zhang Yanzhong, vice grand councilor Kang Gongbi, and secretary Liu Yanzhong presented a memorial and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao privy council director Zuo Qigong, Yu Zhongwen, privy council commissioner Cao Yongyi, vice-commissioner Zhang Yanzhong, vice grand councilor Kang Gongbi, and secretary Liu Yanzhong presented their submission in memorial form.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，遼百官詣軍門叩頭請罪，詔一切釋之。

translations.literal: On xinmao the Liao hundred officials came to the army gate, kowtowed, and begged forgiveness; an edict completely released them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Liao officials came to the army gate, kowtowed, and begged pardon; an edict absolved them all.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上御德勝殿，群臣稱賀。

translations.literal: On renchen the emperor took the throne at Desheng Hall; the assembled ministers proclaimed congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the emperor took his seat in Desheng Hall and the court offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命左企弓等撫定燕京諸州縣。

translations.literal: On jiawu he ordered Zuo Qigong and others to soothe and settle the various prefectures and counties of Yan Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he charged Zuo Qigong and the others with pacifying the prefectures and counties of Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 詔西京官吏曰：「乃者師至燕都，已皆撫定。

translations.literal: An edict to the Western Capital officials and clerks said: "Just now when the army reached the Yan capital, all have already been soothed and settled.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the Western Capital officials read: "The army has reached Yan and all is pacified.

sentences.zh: 唯蕭妃與官屬數人遁去，已發兵追襲，或至彼路，可執以來。

translations.literal: Only Consort Xiao and several officials fled; troops have already been sent to pursue and attack—if they reach your route, seize them and bring them here.
translations.idiomatic: Only Consort Xiao and a few officials have fled; I have sent troops in pursuit. If they come your way, seize them and bring them in.

sentences.zh: 」黃龍府叛，宗輔討平之。

translations.literal: " Huanglong Prefecture rebelled; Zongfu suppressed and pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: " Huanglong Prefecture rebelled; Zongfu put down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 七年正月丁巳，遼奚王回離保僭稱帝。

translations.literal: On dingsi of the first month of year seven the Liao Prince of Xi Huilibao presumptuously declared himself emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the first month of the seventh year the Liao Prince of Xi, Huilibao, proclaimed himself emperor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，遼平州節度使時立愛降。

translations.literal: On jiazi the Liao Pingzhou Military Commissioner Shiliai submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Liao commissioner of Pingzhou, Shiliai, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 詔曲赦平州。

translations.literal: An edict granted a partial amnesty to Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted a partial amnesty to Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 又詔諳班勃極烈曰：「比遣昂徙諸部民人于嶺東，而昂悖戾，騷動煩擾，致多怨叛。

translations.literal: Again an edict to Anban Bojilie said: "Recently We dispatched Ang to relocate the people of various divisions east of the passes; yet Ang was perverse and defiant, causing unrest and trouble, leading to much resentment and rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: A further edict to Anban Bojilie read: "I recently sent Ang to resettle the tribes east of the passes. Ang was disobedient, stirred unrest, and provoked widespread defection.

sentences.zh: 其違命失衆，當置重典。

translations.literal: His defiance of orders and loss of the people's support deserve severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: For defying orders and losing the people's trust he deserves the severest penalty.

sentences.zh: 若或有疑，禁錮以待。

translations.literal: If there is any doubt, hold him in confinement and await further orders.
translations.idiomatic: If the case is not yet clear, hold him under guard pending judgment.

sentences.zh: 」庚午，詔中京都統斡論曰：「聞卿撫定人民，各安其業，朕甚嘉之。

translations.literal: " On gengwu an edict to the Central Capital metropolitan commander Wolun said: "We hear that you have soothed and settled the people, each secure in his occupation—We greatly commend this.
translations.idiomatic: " On gengwu an edict to the Central Capital metropolitan commander Wolun read: "I hear you have settled the people and each holds to his trade—I commend you warmly.

sentences.zh: 回離保聚徒逆命，汝宜計畫，無使滋蔓。

translations.literal: Huilibao is gathering followers in defiance of orders—you should plan accordingly and not let it spread.
translations.idiomatic: Huilibao is rallying followers in rebellion. You must plan against him and keep the trouble from spreading.

sentences.zh: 」壬申，詔招諭回離保。

translations.literal: " On renshen an edict summoned and instructed Huilibao.
translations.idiomatic: " On renshen an edict was issued to summon Huilibao and win him over.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以時立愛言招撫諸部。

translations.literal: On guiyou Shiliai was dispatched with words to soothe and win over the various divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Shiliai was sent to pacify the various tribes.

sentences.zh: 己卯，宋使來議燕京、西京地。

translations.literal: On jimao Song envoys came to negotiate the lands of Yan Capital and the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Song envoys arrived to negotiate over Yanjing and the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宜、錦、乾、顯、成、川、豪、懿等州皆降。

translations.literal: On gengchen the prefectures of Yi, Jin, Qian, Xian, Cheng, Chuan, Hao, and Yi all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the prefectures of Yi, Jin, Qian, Xian, Cheng, Chuan, Hao, and Yi all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔曰：「諸州部族歸附日淺，民心未寧。

translations.literal: On jiashen an edict said: "The various prefectures and tribal divisions have submitted only recently; the people's hearts are not yet settled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen an edict read: "The prefectures and tribes have only lately submitted; the people are still unsettled.

sentences.zh: 今農事將興，可遣分諭典兵之官，無縱軍士動擾人民，以廢農業。」

translations.literal: Now farming is about to begin—dispatch officials to instruct the officers in command of troops: do not allow soldiers to stir and harass the people, thereby destroying agriculture."
translations.idiomatic: Farming season is near. Send word to every military commander: do not let troops harass the people and ruin the harvest."

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉朔，命撒八詔諭興中府，降之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the second month, yiyou, Saba was ordered with an edict to instruct Xingzhong Prefecture to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the second month, yiyou, Saba was sent with an edict to win over Xingzhong Prefecture and accept its surrender.

sentences.zh: 遼來州節度使田顥、隰州刺史杜師回、遷州刺史高永福、潤州刺史張成皆降。

translations.literal: The Liao Military Commissioner of Laizhou Tian Hao, Prefect of Xizhou Du Shihui, Prefect of Qianzhou Gao Yongfu, and Prefect of Runzhou Zhang Cheng all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao commissioner of Laizhou, Tian Hao; the prefect of Xizhou, Du Shihui; the prefect of Qianzhou, Gao Yongfu; and the prefect of Runzhou, Zhang Cheng—all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔諳版勃極烈曰：「郡縣今皆撫定，有逃散未降者，已釋其罪，更宜招諭之。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict to Anban Bojilie said: "The commanderies and counties have now all been soothed and settled; for those who fled and scattered and have not yet submitted, their crimes have already been pardoned—furthermore they should be summoned and instructed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict to Anban Bojilie read: "All counties are pacified. Those still at large have been pardoned; you should now summon and win them over.

sentences.zh: 前後起遷戶民，去鄉未久，豈無懷土之心？

translations.literal: The households relocated earlier and later left their native places not long ago—can they be without longing for home?
translations.idiomatic: Those resettled earlier and later have been gone from home only a short time—surely they still miss their native soil?

sentences.zh: 可令所在有司，深加存恤，毋輒有騷動。

translations.literal: Order the local authorities wherever they are to show deep care and relief, and on no account allow any disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Order local authorities everywhere to care for them well and allow no disturbance.

sentences.zh: 衣食不足者，官賑貸之。

translations.literal: Those lacking food and clothing shall be given relief and loans by the government.
translations.idiomatic: Where food or clothing runs short, the government shall grant relief.

sentences.zh: 」癸巳，詔曰：「頃因兵事未息，諸路關津絕其往來。

translations.literal: " On guisi an edict said: "Recently because military affairs had not ceased, the passes and checkpoints on every route blocked travel.
translations.idiomatic: " On guisi an edict read: "While the war continued, passes on every route were closed to traffic.

sentences.zh: 今天下一家，若仍禁之，非所以便民也。

translations.literal: Now all under Heaven is one family—if travel is still forbidden, that is not how to benefit the people.
translations.idiomatic: Now the realm is united; to keep such bans in force does not serve the people's convenience.

sentences.zh: 自今顯、咸、東京等路往來，聽從其便。

translations.literal: From this day onward, travel to and from the routes of Xian, Xianzhou, and the Eastern Capital shall follow their convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth traffic on the Xian, Xianzhou, and Eastern Capital routes may move as people wish.

sentences.zh: 其間被虜及鬻身者，並許自贖爲良。

translations.literal: Among them those who were captured and those who sold themselves into servitude shall all be permitted to redeem themselves and become commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Captives and those sold into bondage among them may all redeem themselves and regain free status.

sentences.zh: 」仍令馳驛佈告。

translations.literal: " Orders were also given to proclaim this by express relay.
translations.idiomatic: " An express proclamation was ordered as well.

sentences.zh: 興中、宜州復叛。

translations.literal: Xingzhong and Yizhou rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Xingzhong and Yizhou rose in rebellion again.

sentences.zh: 宋使趙良嗣來，請加歲幣以代燕稅，及議畫疆與遣使賀正旦生辰、置榷場交易，並計議西京等事。

translations.literal: The Song envoy Zhao Liangsi came, requesting increased annual tribute in place of Yan taxes, and to discuss boundary demarcation, sending envoys to congratulate on New Year's Day and the imperial birthday, establishing tribute-trade markets, and jointly deliberating matters concerning the Western Capital and others.
translations.idiomatic: The Song envoy Zhao Liangsi came seeking higher annual payments in lieu of Yan taxes, and to negotiate borders, mutual envoys for New Year and the emperor's birthday, tribute-trade markets, and matters concerning the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，銀朮哥、鐸剌如宋。

translations.literal: On guimao Yinzhege and Dolci went to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Yinzhege and Dolci were sent as envoys to Song.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔都統杲曰：「新附之民有材能者，可錄用之。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict to Metropolitan Commander Gao said: "Among the newly submitted people, those with talent and ability may be recruited and employed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict to Commander Gao read: "Among the newly submitted people, employ anyone with talent you find.

sentences.zh: 」戊申，詔平州官與宋使同分割所與燕京六州之地。

translations.literal: " On wushen an edict ordered the officials of Pingzhou together with Song envoys to jointly divide the lands of the six prefectures ceded with Yan Capital.
translations.idiomatic: " On wushen an edict directed Pingzhou officials and Song envoys to divide among themselves the six prefectures granted around Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大赦。

translations.literal: On guichou a great amnesty was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 是月，改平州爲南京，以張覺爲留守。

translations.literal: That month Pingzhou was renamed the Southern Capital, and Zhang Jue was made its garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: That month Pingzhou was made the Southern Capital and Zhang Jue appointed its military governor.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅朔，將誅昂，以習不失諫，杖之七十，仍拘泰州。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, jiayin, Ang was about to be executed; because Xibushi remonstrated, he was beaten seventy blows and still held at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the third month, jiayin, Ang was to be put to death; Xibushi dissuaded the emperor, so Ang was flogged seventy strokes and confined at Taizhou instead.

sentences.zh: 戊午，都統杲等言耶律麻哲告余睹、吳十、鐸刺等謀叛，宜早圖之。

translations.literal: On wuwu Metropolitan Commander Gao and others reported that Yelü Mazhe had informed on Yudu, Wushi, Dolci, and others for plotting rebellion—they should be dealt with early.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Commander Gao and others reported that Yelü Mazhe had accused Yudu, Wushi, Dolci, and others of plotting rebellion and urged early action.

sentences.zh: 上召余睹等，從容謂之曰：「朕得天下，皆我君臣同心同德以成大功，固非汝等之力。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned Yudu and the others and said to them at ease: "When I gained all under Heaven, it was entirely because ruler and ministers shared one heart and one virtue to achieve great success—it was certainly not your power alone.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned Yudu and the others and said calmly: "I won the realm because we ruled and served as one—not because of your strength alone.

sentences.zh: 今聞汝等謀叛，若誠然耶，必須鞍馬甲胄器械之屬，當悉付汝，朕不食言。

translations.literal: Now I hear you are plotting rebellion—if it is truly so, you must need saddles, horses, armor, weapons, and the like; they shall all be given to you—I do not break my word.
translations.idiomatic: "I hear you plot rebellion. If that is true, you will need horses, armor, and arms—I will give you all of it. I do not go back on my word.

sentences.zh: 若再爲我擒，無望免死。

translations.literal: If you are captured by me again, do not hope to escape death.
translations.idiomatic: But if I capture you again, do not expect to live.

sentences.zh: 欲留事朕，無懷異志，吾不汝疑。

translations.literal: If you wish to remain and serve me, harbor no divergent intent—I will not suspect you.
translations.idiomatic: If you mean to stay and serve me, put aside treacherous thoughts—I will not doubt you.

sentences.zh: 」餘睹等皆戰慄不能對。

translations.literal: " Yudu and the others all trembled with fear and could not reply.
translations.idiomatic: " Yudu and the others trembled and could not answer.

sentences.zh: 命杖鐸剌七十，餘並釋之。

translations.literal: Dolci was ordered beaten seventy strokes; the rest were all released.
translations.idiomatic: Dolci was flogged seventy strokes; the others were freed.

sentences.zh: 宋使盧益、趙良嗣、馬宏以國書來。

translations.literal: The Song envoys Lu Yi, Zhao Liangsi, and Ma Hong came with a state letter.
translations.idiomatic: The Song envoys Lu Yi, Zhao Liangsi, and Ma Hong arrived bearing a state letter.

sentences.zh: 四月丁亥，遣斡魯、宗望襲遼主于陰山。

translations.literal: On dinghai in the fourth month Walu and Zongwang were dispatched to raid the Liao ruler at the Yin Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the fourth month Walu and Zongwang were sent to strike the Liao emperor in the Yin Mountains.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，復書于宋。

translations.literal: On renchen a reply letter was sent to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen a reply was sent to Song.

sentences.zh: 師初入燕，遼兵復犯奉聖州，林牙大石壁龍門東二十五里。

translations.literal: As the army had just entered Yan, Liao troops again invaded Fengsheng Prefecture; Linya Dashi fortified himself twenty-five li east of Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: Just as the army entered Yan, Liao forces raided Fengsheng Prefecture again; Linya Dashi fortified a position twenty-five li east of Longmen.

sentences.zh: 都統斡魯聞之，遣照立、婁室、馬和尚等率兵討之，生獲大石，悉降其衆。

translations.literal: Metropolitan Commander Walu on hearing this dispatched Zhaoli, Loushi, Ma Heshang, and others to lead troops to subdue them; they captured Dashi alive and all his followers submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Walu sent Zhaoli, Loushi, Ma Heshang, and others against them; they took Dashi alive and accepted the surrender of his entire force.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔曰：「自今軍事若皆中覆，不無留滯。

translations.literal: On guisi an edict said: "From now on, if all military affairs must be reported to the center for approval, there will inevitably be delay.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi an edict read: "If every military matter must be reported to the center for approval, nothing will move quickly.

sentences.zh: 應此路事務申都統司，餘皆取決樞密院。

translations.literal: Affairs on this route should be reported to the metropolitan command; all others shall be decided by the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Affairs on this front go to the metropolitan command; everything else is decided by the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 」契丹九斤取聚黨興中府作亂，擒之，九斤自殺。

translations.literal: " The Khitan Jiujin gathered followers and made trouble at Xingzhong Prefecture; he was seized, and Jiujin killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: " The Khitan Jiujin raised a band and rebelled at Xingzhong Prefecture; he was captured and killed himself.

sentences.zh: 命習古乃、婆盧火監護長勝軍，及燕京豪族工匠，由松亭關徙之內地。

translations.literal: Xigunai and Boluhuo were ordered to supervise escorting the Ever-Victorious Army and the wealthy clans and artisans of Yan Capital, relocating them inland through Songting Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Xigunai and Boluhuo were ordered to escort the Ever-Victorious Army and Yanjing's noble families and craftsmen inland through Songting Pass.

sentences.zh: 己亥，次儒州。

translations.literal: On jihai the emperor halted at Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the emperor camped at Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 斡魯、宗望等襲遼權六院司喝離質于白水濼，獲之。

translations.literal: Walu, Zongwang, and others raided the Liao acting Six Divisions Commissioner Helizhi at Baishui Marsh and captured him.
