translations.idiomatic: Walu, Zongwang, and others caught the Liao acting commissioner of the Six Divisions, Helizhi, at Baishui Marsh.

sentences.zh: 其宗屬秦王、許王等十五人降。

translations.literal: His clansmen—the Princes of Qin and Xu and fifteen others—submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen of his kinsmen, including the Princes of Qin and Xu, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 聞遼主留輜重青塚，以兵萬人往應州，遣照里、背荅、宗望、婁室、銀朮哥等追襲之。

translations.literal: Hearing that the Liao ruler had left baggage at Qingzhong and was marching ten thousand troops toward Yingzhou, Zhaoli, Beidaa, Zongwang, Loushi, Yinzhege, and others were dispatched to pursue and raid him.
translations.idiomatic: Learning the Liao emperor had left his baggage at Qingzhong and was marching ten thousand men toward Yingzhou, he sent Zhaoli, Beidaa, Zongwang, Loushi, Yinzhege, and others in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 宗望追及遼主，決戰，大敗之，獲其子趙王習泥烈及傳國璽。

translations.literal: Zongwang overtook the Liao ruler, fought a decisive battle, and routed him severely; he captured his son the Prince of Zhao, Xini Lie, and the imperial seal of state.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwang caught the Liao emperor, fought a pitched battle, and routed him; he seized the emperor's son the Prince of Zhao, Xini Lie, and the imperial seal.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，南京留守張覺據城叛。

translations.literal: On jiayin in the fifth month Zhang Jue, garrison commander of the Southern Capital, seized the city and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the fifth month Zhang Jue, military governor of the Southern Capital, rebelled and held the city.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，次野狐嶺。

translations.literal: On bingyin the emperor halted at Yehu Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the emperor camped at Wild Fox Ridge.

sentences.zh: 己巳，次落藜濼。

translations.literal: On jisi the emperor halted at Luoli Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor camped at Luoli Marsh.

sentences.zh: 斡魯等以趙王習泥烈、林牙大石、附馬乳奴等來獻，並上所獲國璽。

translations.literal: Walu and others presented the Prince of Zhao Xini Lie, Linya Dashi, the imperial son-in-law Runu, and others, and submitted the captured imperial seal to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Walu and others presented the Prince of Zhao Xini Lie, Linya Dashi, the imperial son-in-law Runu, and others, and turned over the captured imperial seal.

sentences.zh: 宗雋以所俘遼主子秦王、許王、女奧野等來見。

translations.literal: Zongjun brought the captured sons of the Liao ruler—the Princes of Qin and Xu, the lady Aoye, and others—to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Zongjun presented the Liao emperor's captured sons—the Princes of Qin and Xu—the princess Aoye, and others.

sentences.zh: 奚路都統撻懶攻速古、啜里、鐵尼所部十三岩，皆平之。

translations.literal: The Xi Route metropolitan commander Talan attacked the thirteen strongholds held by Sugu, Chuoli, and Tieni and pacified them all.
translations.idiomatic: Talan, metropolitan commander of the Xi route, stormed the thirteen forts held by Sugu, Chuoli, and Tieni and subdued them all.

sentences.zh: 又遣奚馬和尚攻下達魯古並五院司諸部，執其節度乙列。

translations.literal: Xi Ma Heshang was again dispatched to capture Dalugu and the divisions of the Five Bureaus, seizing their Military Commissioner Yilie.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Heshang of the Xi command was sent to take Dalugu and the divisions of the Five Bureaus, capturing their commissioner Yilie.

sentences.zh: 回離保爲其下所殺。

translations.literal: Huilibao was killed by his own followers.
translations.idiomatic: Huilibao was killed by his own men.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔諭南京官民。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict instructed the officials and people of the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict was issued to the officials and people of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午朔，次鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, renwu, the emperor halted at Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the sixth month, renwu, the emperor camped at Mandarin Duck Marsh.

sentences.zh: 是日，闍母敗張覺于營州。

translations.literal: That day Zhanmu defeated Zhang Jue at Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Zhanmu defeated Zhang Jue at Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上不豫，將還上京，命移賚勃極烈宗翰爲都統，昊勃極烈昱、迭勃極烈斡魯副之，駐兵雲中，以備邊。

translations.literal: On bingshen the emperor was unwell and was about to return to the Supreme Capital; Yilai Bojilie Zonghan was ordered as metropolitan commander, with Hao Bojilie Yu and Die Bojilie Walu as deputies, garrisoning troops at Yunzhong to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the emperor fell ill and prepared to return to the Supreme Capital. Yilai Bojilie Zonghan was named metropolitan commander, with Hao Bojilie Yu and Die Bojilie Walu as deputies, to hold Yunzhong and guard the border.

sentences.zh: 己酉，次斡獨山驛，召諳班勃極烈吳乞買。

translations.literal: On jiyou the emperor halted at Wadu Mountain Post and summoned Anban Bojilie Wuqimai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the emperor stopped at Wadu Mountain Post and summoned Anban Bojilie Wuqimai.

sentences.zh: 七月辛酉，次牛山。

translations.literal: On xinyou in the seventh month the emperor halted at Ox Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the seventh month the emperor camped at Ox Mountain.

sentences.zh: 宗翰還軍中。

translations.literal: Zonghan returned to the army.
translations.idiomatic: Zonghan returned to his command.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, xinsi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first of the eighth month, xinsi, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 乙未，次渾河北。

translations.literal: On yiwei the emperor halted north of the Hun River.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the emperor camped north of the Hun River.

sentences.zh: 諳班勃極烈吳乞買率宗室百官上謁。

translations.literal: Anban Bojilie Wuqimai led the imperial clan and all officials to attend upon him.
translations.idiomatic: Anban Bojilie Wuqimai led the imperial clan and the full court to attend him.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上崩于部堵濼西行宮，年五十六。

translations.literal: On wushen the emperor died at the western traveling palace at Budu Marsh, aged fifty-six.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the emperor died at the western palace at Budu Marsh, at the age of fifty-six.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，梓宮至上京。

translations.literal: On guichou in the ninth month the bier reached the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the ninth month the coffin reached the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，葬宮城西南，建寧神殿。

translations.literal: On yimao he was buried southwest of the palace city, and the Hall of Tranquil Divinity was built.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he was interred southwest of the palace city, and the Hall of Tranquil Divinity was erected.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，諳班勃極烈即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On bingchen Anban Bojilie ascended the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Anban Bojilie took the throne.

sentences.zh: 天會三年三月，上尊諡曰武元皇帝，廟號太祖，立原廟于西京。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Tianhui, the posthumous honorific title Martial Origin Emperor was elevated, the temple name Taizu was granted, and the original temple was established at the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Tianhui year three he was given the posthumous title Martial Origin Emperor, the temple name Taizu, and an ancestral shrine was built in the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 天會十三年二月辛酉，改葬和陵，立《開天啟祚睿德神功之碑》于燕京城南嘗所駐蹕之地。

translations.literal: On xinyou in the second month of the thirteenth year of Tianhui he was reinterred at He Mausoleum, and the stele Opening Heaven, Initiating the Dynasty—Sagacious Virtue and Divine Merit was erected at the place south of Yan Capital where he had once encamped.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the second month of Tianhui year thirteen he was reburied at He Mausoleum, and the stele Opening Heaven, Initiating the Dynasty—Sagacious Virtue and Divine Merit was raised south of Yanjing where he had once held court.

sentences.zh: 皇統四年，改和陵曰睿陵。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Huangtong, He Mausoleum was renamed Rui Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangtong year four He Mausoleum was renamed Rui Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 五年十月，增諡應乾興運昭德定功睿神莊孝仁明大聖武元皇帝。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of year five the augmenting posthumous title was: Responding to Heaven, Raising the Fortune, Proclaiming Virtue, Fixing Merit, Sagacious Spirit, Solemn Filiality, Humane Brightness, Great Sage, Martial Origin Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year five his title was extended to Responding to Heaven, Raising the Fortune, Proclaiming Virtue, Fixing Merit, Sagacious Spirit, Solemn Filiality, Humane Brightness, Great Sage, Martial Origin Emperor.

sentences.zh: 貞元三年十一月，改葬于大房山，仍號睿陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Zhenyuan he was reinterred at Mount Dafang, still named Rui Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Zhenyuan year three he was reburied on Mount Dafang, still called Rui Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：太祖英謨睿略，豁達大度，知人善任，人樂爲用。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Taizu had heroic stratagem and sagacious design, was open and magnanimous, knew men and employed them well—people delighted to serve him.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium reads: Taizu combined daring strategy with keen foresight, magnanimity and breadth of spirit, and a gift for placing the right man in the right post—so that men served him gladly.

sentences.zh: 世祖陰有取遼之志，是以兄弟相授，傳及康宗，遂及太祖。

translations.literal: Shizu secretly harbored the ambition to seize Liao; therefore he transmitted the succession among brothers, passing to Kangzong, and then to Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu secretly aimed at overthrowing Liao, and so passed rule from brother to brother—through Kangzong, and finally to Taizu.

sentences.zh: 臨終以太祖屬穆宗，其素志蓋如是也。

translations.literal: On his deathbed he entrusted Taizu to Muzong—his lifelong purpose was presumably thus.
translations.idiomatic: On his deathbed he entrusted Taizu to Muzong—fulfilling the design he had held all along.

sentences.zh: 初定東京，即除去遼法，減省租稅，用本國制度。

translations.literal: When the Eastern Capital was first secured, Liao laws were immediately abolished, rents and taxes were reduced, and the native Jurchen system was applied.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as the Eastern Capital was secured he abolished Liao law, cut taxes, and imposed Jurchen institutions.

sentences.zh: 遼主播越，宋納歲幣，以幽、薊、武、朔等州與宋，而置南京于平州。

translations.literal: The Liao ruler fled in exile; Song paid annual tribute; the prefectures of You, Ji, Wu, Shuo, and others were given to Song, and the Southern Capital was established at Pingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao emperor was driven into exile; Song paid tribute; You, Ji, Wu, Shuo, and other prefectures went to Song; and the Southern Capital was set at Pingzhou.

sentences.zh: 宋人終不能守燕、代，卒之遼主見獲，宋主被執。

translations.literal: Song men ultimately could not hold Yan and Dai; in the end the Liao ruler was captured, and the Song ruler was seized.
translations.idiomatic: Song could not hold Yan and Dai in the end; the Liao emperor was taken captive, and the Song emperor was seized.

sentences.zh: 雖功成于天會間，而規摹運爲賓自此始。

translations.literal: Although the achievement was fulfilled during the Tianhui period, the grand design and working policy with Song as tributary began from this time.
translations.idiomatic: Though victory was sealed in the Tianhui years, the grand blueprint—and the policy of treating Song as tributary—began here.

sentences.zh: 金有天下百十有九年，太祖數年之間算無遺策，兵無留行，底定大業，傳之子孫。

translations.literal: Jin held all under Heaven for one hundred and nineteen years; within a few years Taizu plotted without a single oversight, the army marched without delay, the great enterprise was settled, and it was transmitted to his sons and grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: Jin ruled for one hundred nineteen years; in only a few years Taizu laid plans without a flaw, armies moved without pause, the great enterprise was secured, and he passed it to his heirs.

sentences.zh: 鳴呼，雄哉！

translations.literal: Alas, how heroic!
translations.idiomatic: Ah—what heroism!
